problem_restatement.input: V79 ZEC lacks robust evidence, V80 failed one-minute cadence, and V81/V82 native fifteen-minute transfers produced no development survivor.
problem_restatement.required_output: Test the exact Hypertrader HYPE five-minute impulse entry mechanism on ZEC after correcting its time-unit and venue-risk defects.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: The single fixed long candidate remains positive after costs and largest-winner removal in development, validation, and holdout with correct next-bar timing and five-times leverage.

source_defects_not_transferred: max_hold_minutes is consumed as a count of five-minute candles, so 23 permits approximately 115 minutes instead of 23
the HYPE implementation permits forty-times leverage despite an internally documented lower venue cap
the source enters at the signal close rather than a subsequent executable bar

data_contract.gap_policy: reset rolling indicators and expire pending entries at every missing five-minute interval

chronology.opening_rule: Open development first; open validation only after a complete development pass; open holdout only after a complete validation pass; do not modify any signal, exit, or risk parameter.

corrected_strategy_contract.entry: all three gates true on one completed five-minute bar, then enter at the next five-minute open
corrected_strategy_contract.maximum_hold_execution: first executable five-minute open at or after 23 elapsed minutes

falsifiers: five-minute source cadence exceeds the missing-interval bound
development fails any support criterion under either friction profile
validation or holdout fails after an earlier partition passes
largest-winner removal makes net PnL non-positive
corrected wall-clock timing or next-bar execution removes the source-reported edge
runtime parity cannot be demonstrated without changing the frozen contract

development_result.finding: The corrected next-bar, wall-clock, five-times-leverage transfer was negative under both cost profiles; Hypertrader headline results do not transfer to ZEC.
